notablePrerequisites: Pulsemage Advocate does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sky Hussar, causing target opponent to mill cards equal to Sky Hussar's power.
Activate Pulsemage Advocate by tapping it and putting three cards from an opponent's graveyard into their owner's hand, returning Sky Hussar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
